title: A moment to try: Check the urgency
practice: Notice whether anything needs action right now. If it can wait, let your hands rest and take one comfortable breath.

title: A moment to try: Choose where attention goes
practice: Let your eyes settle on one object you chose to notice. Give it a few moments before returning to the screen.

title: A moment to try: Practise a manageable challenge
practice: Choose one manageable part of a familiar task. Try that part, then allow yourself to stop.

title: A moment to try: Notice a thought without obeying it
practice: Let a passing thought finish its sentence. Notice that you can hear it without acting on it.

title: A moment to try: Pause before joining the outrage
practice: Before reacting to a heated message, notice your first impulse. Allow a pause and consider whether a response would help.

title: A moment to try: Make the helpful choice easier
practice: Place one useful object within reach. Let your surroundings make the next small action easier.

title: A moment to try: Use precise words instead of fixed labels
practice: Notice a fixed label you use about yourself. Consider one specific moment instead of treating the label as your whole story.

title: A moment to try: Make room for quiet
practice: Listen to the nearest quiet sound. Leave a little space around it without trying to make the room perfectly silent.

title: A moment to try: Let approval be information
practice: Remember a recent opinion someone shared. Consider what is useful in it while allowing yourself your own choice.

title: A moment to try: Begin before everything feels ready
practice: Choose one tiny beginning. Try it for a moment without waiting for perfect confidence.

title: A moment to try: Reduce the open loops
practice: Choose the one task that matters in this moment. Let the others wait while you take its first small step.

title: A moment to try: Question the message behind the comparison
practice: When comparison appears, notice what the image or message leaves out. Return to one thing you value in your own day.

title: A moment to try: State a clear boundary
practice: If a request feels too much, practise a simple boundary silently: "I cannot do that today." You can use it when appropriate.

title: A moment to try: Name the feeling and the next decision
practice: Notice a feeling without judging it. Then choose whether the next moment needs a pause, support or a small action.

title: A moment to try: Find the simplest useful next step
practice: Look at what is within reach. Choose the simplest useful action available and give it a gentle beginning.

title: A moment to try: Listen to body cues with curiosity
practice: Notice a comfortable point of contact with your chair or the ground. Respond to a basic need if you can.

title: A moment to try: Work with the part you can influence
practice: Consider what you can influence in this situation. Give that part your attention for a moment.

title: A moment to try: Choose some time without an audience
practice: Allow one small activity to belong only to you. There is no need to share or prove it.

title: A moment to try: Compare with more context
practice: If you compare two lives, notice a difference in circumstances. Let that context soften a quick conclusion.

title: A moment to try: Return to what is happening now
practice: Notice one colour, one sound and one point of contact. Let them bring your attention back to where you are.

title: A moment to try: Choose within real circumstances
practice: Consider the choices your real circumstances allow. Choose one manageable next step and keep room to adjust.
